scope: Local policy-map correctness and bounded-render observations from the HTTPS Chromium browser suite. These are single-run development measurements, not service capacity or production SLO evidence.

environment.application: Rust debug server behind the local HTTPS test proxy; SvelteKit static production build
environment.database: Disposable Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL container
environment.cache: Disposable Redis test services; no policy-map cache

interactiveGraphLimits.overflowBehavior: Do not mount a partial graph. Explain the counts and offer complete paginated item and relationship tables.

policyRouteEntryChunk.scope: The policy-route entry chunk only; it excludes other route dependencies and shared application chunks.

verification.browserSuite: make test-browser passed, including application switching, English/Spanish labels, keyboard selection, responsive bounds, read-only behavior, complete tables, 401/403 clearing, and stale-response cancellation.
verification.policyUnitTests: 60 tests passed across four focused test files.

wholeConsoleUnitCoverage.limitation: Vitest instruments isolated console unit/component tests; the full policy page and Svelte Flow interactions are exercised by the separate browser suite, which does not contribute to this coverage report. The authored-logic coverage target is not claimed as achieved for the route/component.

verification.lint: Focused console lint passed before the browser run.
verification.localization: 429 shared and 298 administration messages per language passed parity and placeholder checks.

limitations: Browser timings are single observations on one local host with a warm test environment; they are not benchmarks or capacity promises.
The 512-node/2048-relationship fixture rendered all 512 graph nodes in the DOM, which motivated the explicit interactive graph cap.
The 2048-node/8192-relationship fixtures are synthetic and do not measure database query execution at production cardinality.
The reported browser heap is total tab heap after rendering and is not an incremental graph allocation measurement.
Cold-cache, multi-host, production-device, concurrent-administrator, and sustained-load behavior remain unmeasured.
The complete page and graph component are verified in the browser suite, but their unit instrumentation coverage remains incomplete as recorded above.
